title: Your Life as Every Rank in the Ottoman Empire (44 Are Strangled)
hook: At eight years old you're taken from your village and legally become property of the Sultan. Some of you rise higher than any king in Europe ever will. It never stops being someone else's leash.
body: POV: a composite Balkan peasant boy who climbs the real, documented Ottoman devshirme ("kul") system -- Acemi Oglan (VERIFIED: the child levy, roughly one boy per 40 households, ages 8-20) to Janissary (VERIFIED entry wage 3 akce/day plus clothing and weapons allowances; forbidden to marry) to Corbaci, an officer rank whose title literally translates to "soup-maker" (VERIFIED, tied to the regimental cauldron whose overturning was the corps' real signal of mutiny) to Sanjakbey, a district governor (VERIFIED ziamet revenue band, 20,000-99,999 akce/year) to Beylerbey/Pasha, a provincial governor (VERIFIED hass revenue band, 100,000+ akce/year, three horsetails) to Vizier, a seat on the Imperial Council beneath the real, documented Tower of Justice grille the Sultan or his mother could watch through unseen -- to Grand Vizier (Sadrazam), holding the Sultan's own seal. The midpoint reversal is grounded in the real 1622 Janissary mutiny that deposed and killed 17-year-old Sultan Osman II, the first Ottoman sultan ever killed by his own soldiers. The apex cost is a verified historical number: of 284 men who ever held the office of Grand Vizier, 44 were strangled on direct order of the sultan they served. You, Elena, Davud Aga, and Yusuf are a FICTIONAL COMPOSITE; no real historical figure is depicted as this episode's protagonist. Watch the whole series -- every life, every level, every ladder somebody has to climb from the bottom. For educational and entertainment purposes.
pinned: Real fact: of the 284 men who ever held the office of Ottoman Grand Vizier, 44 were strangled on direct order of the sultan they served -- roughly 1 in 6. The office could outrank every free-born noble in the empire, and it still couldn't buy you a trial. Which level would you stop climbing at?
poll: Which level costs the most? LEVEL 02 (Acemi Oglan -- taken from your family at 8) / LEVEL 04 (Corbaci -- the cauldron mutiny that kills a sultan) / LEVEL 07 (Vizier -- you never know if the Tower of Justice is watching) / LEVEL 08 (Grand Vizier -- 1 in 6 get the silk cord)
